notes_for_editor: Only one page (Kemnow's listing) concerns the lookout itself, and it records no built tower; the USGS and Wild Montana pages supply location and trail context only. The 1939 notice names the peak among points where a need had been shown; it does not say for what, and it records no tower. The record's status, kind and access stay unknown. Whether a lookout was ever built is unresolved. Story is short because the evidence is thin; no source describes the site today. The USGS entry gives the location, not the lookout, and corroborates the 11N-6W-23 code.
